vision.name: Namekian Refined Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Attacks performed by your MP deal +1 life card. Whenever a Drill you own enters play during combat, gain 2 stages.
[Instant] POWER: Use when you would Rejuvenate any number of cards during combat. Banish them instead to search your Life Deck for a Styled or Named Drill and place it into play.
